blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A civil society organization threw its support behind Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) chair Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim as chief minister of the incoming first regular Bangsamoro Parliament. Datu Tokz Abudulrahman, convenor of the Save Bangsamoro Movement (SBM), said his group relayed its preference for Ebrahim in a letter to President Ferdinand Jr., noting the MILF chair’s return as chief minister could “significantly advance the Bangsamoro peace process.” The group urged Marcos to seriously consider Ebrahim’s role in restoring confidence among peace stakeholders, as it cautioned him against interfering in the parliamentary process governing the selection of […]...
